quotes.text: Auto labeling is not about catching infractions. It is about lifting the baseline so fewer infractions exist.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes auto-labeling from policing to raising the default level of protection.

quotes.text: Co-pilot does not save you from structure. It amplifies it. The guardrails make its answers short, sober and defensible. The witness speaks because the archive exists.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes clear that Copilot quality depends on governed document structure.

quotes.text: People think leaks come from hackers. They don't, they come from kindness, from convenience, from doors held open for strangers that looked like colleagues. Oversharing is not an incident, it is a habit.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Pinpoints oversharing habits, not attackers, as the root cause of most leaks.

quotes.text: People think governance is a policy binder. It isn't, it is a rhythm, a ritual that keeps the city awake so decay can't take root. Run it as a monthly drumbeat with four beats: see, decide, adjust, teach.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Offers a concrete, repeatable governance cadence instead of a static policy document.

quotes.text: Most miss that DLP is not punishment. It is the short road. A blocked attachment with a named policy is a map, not a scold.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Positions DLP denials as guidance that teaches the right path.

takeaways: Document management works when Dynamics 365 holds the events, SharePoint holds the evidence in working, published and records libraries, Purview enforces the law, and Copilot acts as a witness that cites its sources.

Content types, required metadata, a small sensitivity label set, auto-labeling, event-based retention and DLP that names its policies turn attachments and copies into governed links with one source of truth.
A short monthly cadence of see, decide, adjust and teach, using activity explorer and DSPM for AI, plus time-boxed exceptions with justification keeps the system from drifting back into chaos.
hook: Contracts get attached, forwarded and edited until nobody can prove which version was approved, and Copilot happily surfaces whatever was overshared. This episode is for Dynamics 365 and Microsoft 365 architects, admins and compliance owners who want a blueprint that ties Dynamics records to SharePoint libraries, Purview labels, retention and DLP, and Copilot answers with citations.
